title: Fix wave ships through mitosis items with local holds before any pull request
context: The owner asked for the fix wave to be dispatched with mitosis through its items pathway. Mitosis 0.2.0's draft pull request body and title do not satisfy the repository's centralized pull-request tool, and the repository treats the local suite, not CI, as the gate.
options: let mitosis push and open pull requests through a wrapper around the PR tool
run mitosis with --no-push, validate each held branch locally, review it, then push and open each pull request through the PR tool by hand
outcome: Run with --no-push from feature branch docs/note-fix-wave-spec (the spec PR #140), with a Flutter acceptance wrapper that maps flutter test exit codes onto mitosis's pass, fail and inconclusive contract and treats a test that fails to compile only because its named behaviour is absent as a failure. Each held branch gets the full local suite and an independent review before its pull request opens through the PR tool.
